source.title: Avoid checking out main when merging C2 PRs from task worktrees
source.objective: C2 integration helpers invoking gh pr merge from a secondary codex-roadmap worktree fail because main is already checked out in the canonical worktree. Use an explicit repository/API merge path or another safe approach that does not check out main in the task worktree.
